title: Job status
summary: When sales last synced from {pos} and when inventory was last uploaded, and what the colours mean.

blocks.text: The job status card shows the last run of the two background jobs:

items: **Sales sync ({pos})**: copies the previous day's orders from {pos} every night. A missed night is caught up on the next run.
**Inventory upload**: the last time a file was uploaded (or {pos}'s nightly snapshot, when that is on).
**Red**: failed. Open the detail text to see why.

blocks.text: A red sales sync usually means the {pos} connection needs attention. An admin can check it on [Integrations](page:integrations) with Test connection.
